about: Classes 3.0 step 1a (docs/design/rev4-primitives.md): one fixture item per primitive and batch row, written in data only, loaded with addItems() by test/prim-*.test.ts. Test only: not game content. The tests read their numbers from here.

perks.name: Ping (test)
perks.text: Costs {=effects.0.ap} AP. When it is done, gain {=effects.0.effects.0.value} perk AP (a grant_action's nested `when: acted` effect: no `if.action`).

relics.name: Acted on reload (test)
relics.text: After a reload of yours, gain {=effects.0.value} perk AP, once a turn.

relics.name: Acted on Analyze (test)
relics.text: After you Analyze, the target is Marked.

relics.name: Still (test)
relics.text: Spot rolls against you are {=effects.0.value} (the trigger spot).

relics.name: Cover to cover (test)
relics.text: A move that ends next to cover sets a flag.

relics.name: Mercy blow (test)
relics.text: Your hit also deals a nonlethal blow that counts as a prayer.

relics.name: Tending touch (test)
relics.text: Your hit heals you a little, as tending.

relics.name: Pinning hit (test)
relics.text: Your hit adds {=effects.0.value} Pressure to its target (the resource row pressure).

relics.name: Marked bonus (test)
relics.text: Against a Marked target your damage is a number block (P3): +{=effects.0.value.per.0.value|pct}% while it is Marked.

relics.name: Guard to AP (test)
relics.text: After a reload, gain perk AP equal to your Guard (P3 res:guard), at most {=effects.0.value.max}.

relics.name: Spend it all (test)
relics.text: Your hit spends all your Guard (value all); the turn's end loses all your Momentum (value zero).

relics.name: Sources (test)
relics.text: Damage you take gives you a shield of half of it (event:amount); your hit heals you a tenth of your max HP (self:max_hp).

relics.name: Brace for it (test)
relics.text: Once a round, as your reaction (a protective one), a hit you take is multiplied by {=effects.0.value}.

relics.name: Reaction watcher (test)
relics.text: Each time you make a protective reaction, mark a flag (the trigger reaction).

relics.name: MP on hit (test)
relics.text: Your hit gives you {=effects.0.value} MP, with an Emanator in hand.
